presentation_good_case.rationale: Clean presentation deck must achieve at least 0.80 quality score.

presentation_bad_duplicate_case.rationale: Severe duplicate slides must be detected and capped below 0.65.

handout_good_case.rationale: Structured continuous reading handout must meet high reading flow standard.

handout_orphan_heading.rationale: Orphan heading at bottom of page must trigger non-blocking warning.

handout_tiny_text.rationale: Unreadable body font size must block export.

worksheet_good_case.rationale: Scaffolded inquiry worksheet with active workspace must score >= 0.80.

worksheet_answer_leakage.rationale: Leaked explanation or answer in prompt must strictly block export.

worksheet_quiz_collapse.rationale: Collapsing inquiry into 10 consecutive factual recall questions must trigger error.

scientific_good_case.rationale: Grounded KTI document with complete BAB structure must score >= 0.80.

scientific_unsupported_claim.rationale: Unsupported empirical claim presented as fact must block academic export.

scientific_bab_inversion.rationale: BAB hierarchy inversion must block export.
